description: This file is a shell script used during system initialization or diagnostics in a Linux-based embedded system (OpenWrt/LEDE). It manages the state of a status LED, including restoring trigger settings and controlling LED behavior during different system states (preinit, failsafe, upgrade, done).

methods.name: status_led_restore_trigger
methods.description: Restores the LED trigger to its default value based on the device tree settings.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED's blinking state based on the system initialization phase or errors.
